scope: Single frozen public passage, not full repository

claims.description: The Lakes are primarily owned by Louisiana State University, with exceptions for City Park Lake and Lake Erie.
claims.name: Louisiana State University owns the Lakes

claims.description: City Park Lake is an exception to LSU ownership and is owned by the City-Parish of Baton Rouge.
claims.name: City-Parish of Baton Rouge owns City Park Lake

claims.description: Lake Erie is an exception to LSU ownership and is owned by the City-Parish of Baton Rouge.
claims.name: City-Parish of Baton Rouge owns Lake Erie

claims.description: Park spaces within the study area are managed by The Recreation and Park Commission for the Parish of East Baton Rouge (BREC).
claims.name: BREC manages park spaces
claims.target: The Recreation and Park Commission for the Parish of East Baton Rouge (BREC)

claims.description: BREC is The Recreation and Park Commission for the Parish of East Baton Rouge, which manages park spaces within the study area.
claims.name: The Recreation and Park Commission for the Parish of East Baton Rouge (BREC)

claims.description: Ownership rests with only two entities: Louisiana State University and the City-Parish of Baton Rouge.
claims.name: ownership rests with two entities

claims.description: Residents of neighborhoods lining the study area have a strong sense of implied ownership of the Lakes due to their immediate proximity.
claims.name: implied ownership of the Lakes

claims.description: Many residents have co-opted the lake edges into private gardens, reserves, and boat launches.
claims.name: co-opted lake edges

claims.description: Residents' additions to lake edges can create moments of charm and beauty that add to the cultural integrity of the Lakes.
claims.name: additions add cultural integrity

claims.description: Residents' additions to lake edges can also create issues for lake operations and maintenance as well as adjacent property owners.
claims.name: additions create issues

claims.description: The master planning process made every effort to ensure that residents along the Lakes were engaged and that the sense of ownership is preserved in the Master Plan.
claims.name: preserve resident sense of ownership
